input.sql: select FLX_ANN_MOI, count(*), sum(PRS_REM_MNT), sum(FLT_REM_MNT), sum(PRS_PAI_MNT), min(SOI_ANN), max(SOI_ANN) from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS group by 1 order by 1

select count_if(PRS_REM_MNT<>0) a, count_if(FLT_REM_MNT<>0) b, count_if(PRS_REM_MNT<>0 and FLT_REM_MNT<>0) ab, count_if(PRS_REM_MNT is null) an, count_if(FLT_REM_MNT is null) bn from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS

input.final_sql: select FLX_ANN_MOI as month, sum(PRS_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed, sum(PRS_REM_MNT) - lag(sum(PRS_REM_MNT)) over (order by FLX_ANN_MOI) as change_from_prev from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS group by FLX_ANN_MOI order by FLX_ANN_MOI
